notes.title: Patch v1.1.1
notes.content: [p][b][i]Update: Chest & Upgrade System + Performance Improvements[/i][/b][/p][list][*][p]Chest is now available inside the house.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrade system added: locked slots in both backpacks and chest can now be unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Performance improvements and minor bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback![/p]

notes.title: Patch v1.1.0
notes.content:
[p]Thanks to your feedback and support, the demo has reached a more complete and polished state with this update. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h3]Quest Line Expanded[/h3][list][*][p]Crafting table quests are now available.[/p][/*][*][p]Altar quests have been added and are now accessible.[/p][/*][*][p]New fish stall quests have been added.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay Tweaks[/h3][list][*][p]Fish stall feature has been completely reworked for better flow.[/p][/*][*][p]The map layout has been refined to improve navigation and atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p]Magic Forest mushrooms now glow slightly to make them easier to find.[/p][/*][*][p]General gameplay tweaks for a smoother experience.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes & Visual Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed various collision issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Performance improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of visual polish and bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks so much for playing, sharing feedback, and just being here. It really helps shape the game.
We hope you enjoy the update and there’s more to come![/p][p][/p][p]If you have any thoughts or run into issues, feel free to share your feedback on our [url="https://discord.gg/PfdnweUGGv"]Discord[/url] we’d love to hear from you :)[/p]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.17
notes.content: [p][b][i]Update: Visual Improvements & Quest Overhaul[/i][/b][/p][list][*][p]Visuals of the Fish Stall have been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]The quest system has been completely reworked, paving the way for upcoming content.[/p][/*][*][p]General performance and visual quality improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Various bugs have been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback![/p]

notes.content: [p][i][b]Update: Critical Fixes & Achievement Improvements[/b][/i][/p][list][*][p]The new in-game achievement system has been added[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a critical bug where players could fall off the boat.[/p][/*][*][p]Local save data is now properly separated per player.[/p][/*][*][p]Quest rewards now check for available inventory space before being granted.[/p][/*][*][p]Several other minor bugs have been resolved.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for your continued support and feedback![/p]
